test_title: PYST 35: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Quantitative Aptitude (Held On: 20 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: 400 apples were bought at ₹1220 per hundred and were sold at a profit of ₹920. Find the selling price (in ₹) per dozen of apples.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Cost Price per dozen = (1220 ÷ 100) × 12 = ₹146.4

Profit per dozen = (920 ÷ 400) × 12 = ₹27.6

Selling Price per dozen = Cost Price + Profit

Selling Price per dozen = 146.4 + 27.6 = ₹174

**∴ The correct answer is ₹174.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total number of apples = 400

Cost price of 100 apples = ₹1220

Total profit on selling all apples = ₹
